title: Aureline M5 claim-history diff
description: Canonical per-domain claim-history-diff record minted by the public-proof-ledger and claim-history-diff lane over the frozen M5 supported-line-transparency matrix. Turns a change in the external proof backing an active supported line into visible, machine-checkable program truth instead of an implicit docs mismatch: it records the diff scope a proof change sits in — a freshness change (a compatibility report, benchmark / evidence packet, support-window statement, known-limits set, or deprecation / successor report changed freshness state or moved from current to retest-pending), a scope narrowing (a proof source narrowed the claim scope it backs), or a release-line reassociation (a proof source changed the exact build / release-line identity it is bound to). Names the diff scope, binds the resolved supported-line identity, the affected proof-source reference, the previous-versus-current claim-state reference, and the active diff reason so release / help, About, docs, support, and procurement surfaces can show current-versus-previous claim-state history and follow the same currentness rules as internal release control rather than rereading raw compatibility reports by hand. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's proof posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
